The plot prices in DHA Lahore varies from phase to phase. However, the average rates are detailed below:

One Kanal Bungalow price in DHA starts from Rs 17,500,000 and goes till 70,000,000. The average price of five Marla newly built house is Rs 1.8 crore to Rs 2 crore and ten Marla is Rs 2 crore to 2.5 crore. Average price for two Kanal house fluctuates between Rs 18,500,000 and Rs 35,000,000. And if you desires to buy fully furnished house in DHA then you should have twelve crore rupees in your pocket.

One Kanal residential plot price ranges from 62 lac to 2 crore. You can buy five Marla plot in price varying between 22 lac and 54 lac. Commercial plot prices diverges from 2.2 crore to 6 crore for 4 Marla and from seven crore to ten crore for 8marla.

The rental charges in DHA are also very high. You can get one portion of 1 Kanal house in DHA for rent between Rs 37,000 and 275,000. Two Canal fully furnished house costs around two lac per month. You may get full five Marla house for 40 to 48 thousand rupees per month.

Highest property prices depicts the quality of area. Rapid development is taking place in its new phases. It is no doubt great place to live. Another quality of DHA is that it is connected to Lahore Ring Road that is heart of Lahore. Ring Road connects the main areas of the city so DHA location near Ring Road has increased worth of the area. DHA Phase 5 is best if you want to buy a house. And if you are looking for plots to invest, then you should consider the newly launched Phases 7, 8, 9. Finding plots in Phase 1, 2, 3 have become difficult and if found, they are highly expensive. The property rates in Phase IV and V are also following Phase 1, 2 and 3. The phase 6, 7 and 9 are under development and viewed as best option for investment as rate of properties is low there. source **[LINK](https://saibanproperties.wordpress.com/2016/01/28/property-in-dha-lahore-for-sale-purchase-or-rent/)**
